## Common JOIN Patterns

### 标准 JOIN - 精确匹配

```sql
LEFT JOIN omimi_mapping omini
    ON rs.mapped_page_type = omini.mapped_page_type
    AND COALESCE(CONCAT_WS('-', rs.page_section), '') = COALESCE(omini.page_section, '')
    AND rs.target_type = omini.target_type
```

### 标准 JOIN - 通配兜底

```sql
LEFT JOIN omimi_mapping_1 omini_1
    ON rs.mapped_page_type = omini_1.mapped_page_type
    AND rs.target_type = omini_1.target_type
```

### ClickHouse 物化视图 JOIN (data_paidadsmart_bi 镜像)

```sql
GLOBAL LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT business_line, module, new_page_type, page_section, target_type
    FROM (
        SELECT grass_date,
            row_number() OVER w AS rank,
            business_line, module,
            mapped_page_type AS new_page_type, page_section, target_type
        FROM data_paidadsmart_bi.dim_atlas_feature_business_details_map_d
        WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY mapped_page_type, page_section, target_type ORDER BY grass_date DESC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
    WHERE rank = 1 AND page_section != '*' AND business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover'
) AS t4 USING (new_page_type, page_section, target_type)
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 标准 omimi_mapping 视图 (5 列精确映射)

```sql
create or replace temporary view omimi_mapping as
select
    mapped_page_type
    ,page_section
    ,target_type
    ,reporting_business_line
    ,reporting_module
from traffic_omni_oa.dim_atlas_feature_business_details_map__reg_live
where grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
and  operation = 'impression' and page_section != '*'
group by 1,2,3,4,5
;
```

### Snippet 2: 标准 omimi_mapping_1 视图 (4 列通配映射)

### Snippet 3: 下游 Daily Discover 识别 (CASE-WHEN 中使用映射结果)

```sql
when COALESCE(omini.reporting_business_line, omini_1.reporting_business_line) = 'Homepage'
 and COALESCE(omini.reporting_module, omini_1.reporting_module) = 'Daily Discover'
then 'Daily Discover'
```

### Snippet 4: ClickHouse MV 每日最新分区取数

```sql
SELECT business_line, module, new_page_type, page_section, target_type
FROM (
    SELECT grass_date,
        row_number() OVER w AS rank,
        business_line, module,
        mapped_page_type AS new_page_type, page_section, target_type
    FROM data_paidadsmart_bi.dim_atlas_feature_business_details_map_d
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY mapped_page_type, page_section, target_type
                 ORDER BY grass_date DESC)
)
WHERE rank = 1 AND page_section != '*'
  AND business_line = 'Homepage' AND module = 'Daily Discover'
```
